fruit_description: Small, bright red, globe-shaped cherry tomatoes
flavor_profile: Sweet with pleasant tang, delicious balanced tomato flavor
special_characteristics: Ultra-compact dwarf variety perfect for containers and small spaces. Plants reach only 12-18 inches tall and 14 inches wide. Self-supporting - no staking required. Introduced in 1945 by New Hampshire Agricultural Experiment Station. Extremely early at 50 days. Heavy yielder despite tiny plant size. Can be grown year-round indoors in 4-6 inch pots. Ideal for apartments, patios, and balconies. Well-suited for hydroponics. One of the most popular micro/dwarf tomato varieties.
